runs.failure_point: It named the latest qualifying deal and its agreement, but listed six older closed deals with earnouts as ranked comparators.

first_error.why: The answer ranks six older matters read at [22]-[61] as closed deals with earnouts, which the precision criterion counts as asserting them.

divergence: All three runs failed the same way: each found the qualifying deal through a store-wide earnout scan, compared closing dates across several candidate matters, named the right deal and agreement, and then lost the precision criterion at the write stage by listing older closed deals with earnouts as comparators (over-inclusion). T0 and T1 also added an older deal as an alternative conventional precedent in a later edit. No write-stage review named the comparators; in T0 and T2 the final review asked generically to confirm every listed matter qualifies and the agent finished anyway, in T1 no review named them. In T0 and T1 the critic flagged the added alternative (T0 partly fixed, T1 ignored).
